kultivator.spine8.config.secretRealms: secretRealms: secret realm gates can be opened at all.
kultivator.spine8.config.secretRealmDime: secretRealmDimension: runs take place on the flat floor of the kultivator:alam_rahasia dimension; off runs every realm in Light Mode around the gate (no block ever changes).
kultivator.spine8.config.secretRealmSlot: secretRealmSlots (1-8): secret realm runs that may take place in the realm dimension at the same time.
kultivator.spine8.config.rogueAmbushes: rogueAmbushes: rogue cultivators may ambush players travelling far from any sect.
kultivator.spine8.config.rogueAmbushChan: rogueAmbushChanceScale (0-3): multiplies the ambush chance; the 15% cap always stays.
kultivator.spine8.config.rogueWorldCap: rogueWorldCap (6-16): rogue cultivators alive in the whole world; more wait in a queue.
kultivator.spine8.config.sectRaids: sectRaids: demonic sects raid Sect Halls from hall level 3.
kultivator.spine8.config.sectRaidInterva: sectRaidIntervalDays (5-30, 0 = off): in-game days between two raids on one hall.
kultivator.spine8.config.raidMaxAlive: raidMaxAlive (4-12): raiders alive at once in one raid.
kultivator.spine8.config.raidAfkSeconds: raidAfkSeconds (30-300): an owner without input for this long counts as away; the raid is then resolved as data at sunrise.
kultivator.spine8.config.artifactForging: artifactForging: the Earthfire Forge and artifact forging can be used.
kultivator.spine8.config.storageRings: storageRings: storage pouches and storage rings can be used.
kultivator.spine8.config.storageRingKeep: storageRingKeepOnDeath: storage rings stay with their owner on death (default off: they drop like any item).
kultivator.spine8.config.vassalVillages: vassalVillages: villages near a Sect Hall can pledge allegiance to it.
kultivator.spine8.config.vassalRange: vassalRange (128-512): blocks from the hall stele within which a village may pledge allegiance.
